---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

**Environment:** OS/version, Better FTP version or commit, installation method, and protocol.

**Steps:** Minimal steps to reproduce, with expected and actual behavior.

**Evidence:** Redacted errors or screenshots. Never include credentials, private keys, private server addresses, or sensitive paths. For transfer issues, include file sizes and whether the connection was interrupted.

**Frequency:** Always or intermittent; note whether retry or reconnect changes the result.
